verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's docs describe Kubernetes-based node pools with cluster-autoscaler scaling for GPU/CPU/memory demand (coreweave-docs-3, coreweave-docs-16, coreweave-docs-30) and pay-as-you-go Spot Node Pools for burst capacity (coreweave-docs-4, coreweave-docs-23), but these are infrastructure-level node autoscaling, not a serverless 'deploy code, scale to zero' function/endpoint model. There is no evidence of a FaaS-style deployment workflow, per-request scale-to-zero inference endpoints, or a serverless runtime abstraction for arbitrary developer code.
